Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Punchline: A curated, searchable marketplace for Dalamud plugins.
Description: Omega by the Dalagab Group is a visual Dalamud plugin marketplace with Spotlight, Store-style Discover rich/fallback listings and product pages, standard plugin screenshots, Library/Collections, Updates, searchable tags and filters, explicit repository provenance, repository-choice installation delegated to Dalamud, and one hash-checked SQLite catalog built online.
